content: Long periods of power cuts during summer do more than just inconvenience us. Students have to study in dim light from phone screens, small shopkeepers lose perishable goods, and craftsmen like tailors and welders lose hours they cannot make up. Those who can buy solar panels or backup batteries manage better, which makes the gap between rich and poor bigger. Economists say that steady electricity is not a luxury but a basic need for learning and earning.

questions.answer: Mera matlab tha ke jab power cut hoti hai, students ko sirf phone screen ki weak roshni me padhai karni padti hai, jis se unki concentration aur vision dono affect hoti hain. Ye situation bilkul sach hai kyun ke phone screens natural light se kaafi kam bright hoti hain aur lambe samay tak padhai karna physically aur mentally stressful ban jata hai.

questions.answer: Jab ek community ek single diesel generator par depend karti hai aur woh generator bar bar fail hota hai, to yeh samajhna zaroori hai ke electricity bas ek convenience nahi, balke ek basic need hai. Logon ko study, work, aur basic services ke liye continuous power chahiye; generator ki failure se students padhai mein rukawat, small businesses apna maal kharaab karte, aur skilled workers ka time waste hota. Is tarah se power ki kami se economic inequality barh jati hai aur poor log aur bhi marginalize ho jate.
